ValidationRule.description: This validates that HCM Sales Consultants can only edit opportunities with WX products
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.OpportunityTrigger__c ) , NOT(ISNEW()), TEXT( NSP_PrimaryProduct__c ) <> "WX", ISBLANK(NSP_Product_Interest__c) , $UserRole.DeveloperName ="HCM_Sales_Consultant", NOT( OR( CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'System Admin' ) , $Profile.Name = "Data Migration", $Profile.Name = "Sales Administrator" ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: HCM Sales Consultants can modify only WX Opportunities.
